'''17786''' was the designation given to one of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. They were the offspring of [[Nial Declann]]. At some point, they had been recruited into the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Arden Lyn]]'s ranks to be trained in [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]]. Officially, Lyn did this as part of her mission to take out the "[[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]," but in actuality, she did this as part of her plan to launch an attempted coup against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. However, they later went into hiding with his mentor alongside his fellow student, the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]], after Lyn's plot had been exposed to Palpatine via [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. They later resurfaced during the [[Zaarin insurrection]], having participated alongside Lyn, Thok, and the rest of the [[Zaarin coup forces]] in capturing the Emperor by using their combined [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities to subdue the mighty [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StormtrooperVictory.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Stormtrooper victory stance.]]
17786 first appeared in the fighting game ''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi]]'', as a secret character. However, they were never given a name nor appeared in any other ''[[Star Wars]]''-related works until the release of the second part of the blog ''[[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]]''. Similarly, because they were a secret character, it was left ambiguous as to whether they were aligned with Lyn or not, as well as whether they were canonical, until the same blog established that they were one of Lyn's students.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" /> They had at least two skins, the standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|Stormtrooper attire]] and the [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|Scout trooper uniform]].<ref name="Masters of TK>''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi]]''</ref>
